name: Guide to Developing a National Cybersecurity Strategy (3rd Edition, 2025)
description: Third edition (2025) — Guide to Developing a National Cybersecurity Strategy. Multi-stakeholder international reference guide coordinated by the ITU (with World Bank, Commonwealth Secretariat, NATO CCDCOE, ENISA, OAS, GFCE, Microsoft, et al.) for initiating, drafting, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating National Cybersecurity Strategies across five lifecycle phases.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by International Telecommunication Union (itu.int) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for International Telecommunication Union (itu.int).
